ActorTalk: Hey, Commandant! Didn't expect to see you here. This crowd is huge! Is there some kind of competition going on?
It's a pop-up food stall that just opened.
Wait... this smell is really familiar? I feel like I know it from somewhere.
What they're serving appears to be the military ration packs made exclusively for F.O.S.
Ration packs? Hmm... but if they're the F.O.S. exclusive ones... ugh, talk about a tough call!
Ah, whatever, I'm getting in line to try it anyway!
